Everything checks out — build, type-check, and lint all pass clean. Here's a summary of what changed:

**1. Flow: Buat Order → Bayar langsung** ([order-actions.ts](src/lib/order-actions.ts:220))
`confirmOrderAction` now redirects straight to `/meja/[id]/bayar` instead of back to the table list. `OrderSummary` stays untouched as a fallback for revisiting an occupied table.

**2. Order-input lag** ([OrderCart.tsx](src/components/OrderCart.tsx), [order-actions.ts](src/lib/order-actions.ts))
- Qty +/-, remove, and add-to-cart now update the UI instantly via `useOptimistic`, before the server round-trip finishes.
- Button disabling is now per-item (via a `pendingKeys` set) instead of locking the whole screen — you can tap other items while one is still saving.
- Server-side total recalculation (`recomputeOrderTotal` → `adjustOrderTotal`) now applies an incremental delta instead of re-selecting and re-summing every order item on every click — cuts one query, and stops scaling with cart size.
- A just-added item's row (before the server confirms it) is kept disabled to avoid a race where you could decrement/remove an item that doesn't exist in the DB yet.

**3. Table sort order** ([page.tsx](src/app/(app)/page.tsx))
Tables now sort with `localeCompare(..., { numeric: true })` on `nama` after fetch, so "Meja 1, 2, ... 10" order correctly instead of by creation time.

I couldn't log into the live app to click-test (it's PIN-gated and I don't have the cashier PIN), so verification here is build + type-check + lint + code review, not an actual click-through. untuk solve ini??

[ask] Saat coba sendiri, saya kelupaan utk instruksikan commit & push per masing-masing perubahan, sehingga di commit & push ke GitHub lnsg 1 bundling app end to end features. 

bagaimana instruksikan ke AI nya utk itu ya? Bagaimana agar AI nya bisa mengukur changes sekian besar maka perlu commit, dan mana yg tidak perlu lnsg commit?
entries.responseText:
Sudah aku tambahkan section baru di [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) berisi rule commit & push bertahap, dengan tiga bagian:

1. **Kapan wajib commit+push segera** — tiap task/sub-task dari task list selesai & terverifikasi, tiap unit independen (migration, endpoint, komponen, bug fix), sebelum pindah ke bagian yang beda konsep, sebelum perubahan berisiko.
2. **Kapan tidak perlu dipisah** — perubahan kecil yang memang bagian tak terpisahkan dari unit kerja yang sama, kode setengah jadi, atau perubahan yang saling bergantung.
3. **Sinyal diff harus displit** — lebih dari satu concern, banyak file tak berkaitan, atau mencakup beberapa task sekaligus dari task list.

Sesuai pilihanmu, aku tulis rule-nya supaya AI push otomatis tiap commit tanpa nanya dulu (bukan cuma commit lokal). Kalau nanti ada branch/repo tertentu yang kamu mau tetap direview sebelum push, tinggal bilang di awal sesi itu saja — rule ini bisa di-override per sesi.
